results.title: Germany to ban Chinese telecom gear from 5G networks ...
results.snippet: Germany is considering a ban on parts made by Chinese manufacturers Huawei and ZTE in its 5G networks from 2026, government sources told AFP on Wednesday.

results.title: Germany preparing sweeping ban on Chinese mobile network equipment: Report
results.snippet:
Because equipment manufacturers typically supply integrated systems whose components are not always interchangeable, a ban on Chinese-made base stations could effectively exclude Huawei and ZTE from the market.

Alternative suppliers include European companies Nokia and Ericsson, as well as South Korea's Samsung. [...] logo
